artists.name: Dubzy
artists.intro: Derby MC billed on The Grime Show alongside Eyez, Kaygee, Directs and Lox.

claims.text: JDZmedia identified Dubzy as a Derby artist when it published his SPITFIRE session in 2013.
claims.locator: First line of the uploader’s description. Uploaded 22 April 2013.

claims.text: Rinse FM billed Dubzy alongside Eyez, Kaygee, Directs and Lox on The Grime Show in November 2014.

claims.text: Eyez named Dubzy as the artist representing Derby on Mind the Gap.

claims.text: Derby County introduced Eyez as a local grime MC when he joined RamsTV in 2017.

claims.text: Eyez recalled discovering grime through Channel U and his older brother while growing up in Derby.

claims.text: Asked which hometown artists he rated, Eyez named Dubzy and Lox among his picks.
claims.source: The regional grime artists you need to know
